name: qBittorrent
summary: Download files with BitTorrent, from your browser or for Sonarr and Radarr.
description:
qBittorrent downloads files shared over BitTorrent into your Downloads folder. Use its website directly, or let Sonarr and Radarr send it what to fetch.

After installing, open the app's Logs here in the App Store: qBittorrent prints a temporary password for the user admin there. Sign in, then set your own password under Tools > Options > Web UI. Downloads go to /downloads, which is the Downloads folder you choose here (Sonarr and Radarr see the same folder at the same path).

Only download what you have the right to.
publisher: qBittorrent project, image by LinuxServer.io (packaged by HardyOS)
